text: Coffee with Ebony. Her dad's had a fall and fractured his wrist, so she's been driving over to Leeds every other day. She sounded shattered. Ring her sometime next week to see how he's getting on.

Caught up with Eamon and Caroline after the school run. Their youngest, Finn, has had tonsillitis twice this month and might need them out. They're both running on no sleep. Eamon's birthday is end of the month, he's mad into fly fishing at the minute.
Giulia's 40th is Saturday the 14th, drinks at hers from 7pm. She keeps going on about wanting a proper espresso machine, the manual kind. Maybe club together with Freya?
Amir rang. Knee surgery went fine on Tuesday, he's home now but on crutches for six weeks. Bored out of his mind. I'm dropping round on Thursday evening with the PS5 games he asked for.

Long chat with Alice tonight. Her mum got the biopsy results back and it's benign, huge relief. Alice is still knackered from all the hospital runs though. Her brother Tom is flying in from Dubai early March to give her a break. Must send her some flowers this week.
Yara mentioned Yosef has been off work with his back again, slipped disc apparently. Physio on Monday at 10am. Text him tomorrow morning, see if he wants anything picking up.
Luis is into bouldering now, goes three times a week with his flatmate. Birthday's the 22nd.

Bumped into Alessia at Tesco. Her little girl Mia broke her arm on the trampoline last weekend, cast for a month. Mia is apparently loving the attention and wants everyone to sign it. Alessia said she's fine but looked worn out.
Zoe's dog Pepper had an op on her leg yesterday, home and sulking in a cone. Zoe's working from home till Friday to keep an eye on her.
Need to post Valentina's present by Wednesday, she's in Lisbon now and the post takes ages. She said she'd love anything Studio Ghibli.

Jasmine and her husband Dev have finally booked their anniversary trip, Lake Como sometime in June. Ten years! Kasia is doing the kids for them that week. Jasmine's still nervous about leaving the baby though, he's only seven months and has never been away from her overnight. Dev's mum has offered to help Kasia on the weekdays. Must ask Jasmine for the dates so I don't book anything with Kasia that week.
Pick up prescription, return the library books, book car MOT for sometime next week.

Meera called about Tanvi. Tanvi has glandular fever, been in bed nearly three weeks and missing her mocks. Meera is really worried about her falling behind. Should drop off some of those audiobooks for Tanvi, maybe Saturday afternoon. Meera says she's obsessed with Agatha Christie.
Marcus's party is off, his grandad's back in hospital with pneumonia. Marcus is going up to Glasgow on Friday instead. Message him over the weekend.

Santiago said Petra's birthday is the 3rd and she's been hinting about a Kindle, hers died on holiday. He's getting her the case, so I could do the actual Kindle if Claire and Felix chip in. Need to sort it before end of next week.
Ming is vegan now, properly, not just January. Good to know for the dinner.

Spoke to Mariam briefly. Her son Idris starts his chemo the 9th at half 8. She doesn't want a fuss, but I'll make a batch of soup and leave it on the doorstep that week. Yusuf, her husband, has taken unpaid leave to be home.

Lunch with Jorge. He's training for the Manchester half in April, already done 15k. Says his calf has been twinging a bit. His sister Sophie's wedding is over the summer, somewhere in Puglia, and he's best man and terrified of the speech.
Heather's cat Biscuit went missing on Sunday night. She's put posters everywhere. Share her post on the village group and ask Dafydd if he's seen anything on his camera.

Abigail Wright from book club, the one who teaches piano. Her dad had a stroke last month and she's moved back home to Swansea for now to help her mum. Don't forget to send a card, address is in the group chat.
Ebony said Eamon's got a hearing test Friday at 3pm, been struggling to hear in meetings. He's a bit embarrassed about it.
Called Caroline back. Her mum's hip op is now the 18th, not the 11th, so the trip to Cork moves to early December. She asked if I can water the plants while they're away.
Freya's turning 30 next month and absolutely does not want a party. Loves wild swimming, has been eyeing up one of those changing robes. Dryrobe, the green one.
Amir and Giulia are hosting a games night Saturday at 8, bring a dessert. Giulia is coeliac so nothing with flour.
Quick call with Alice. How did her interview go on Monday? Forgot to ask. Text her tonight.
Yosef's daughter Noa has chickenpox, so he can't come to five a side tomorrow night. Poor kid's covered. He's been up with her every night this week.

Grabbed a drink with Luis and his girlfriend Ana. They're moving to Bristol at the end of the month, already found a flat in Bedminster. Ana starts a new nursing job there mid November. Luis is staying remote. Would be nice to do leaving drinks before they go, maybe the Friday before.
Note to self, Alessia hates surprises. Don't do the surprise thing for her birthday again.

Long voice note from Zoe. Her brother Ollie came off his bike on the way to work, broke his collarbone and two ribs. He's in the Royal till at least Wednesday. Their mum is beside herself and Zoe is trying to hold everyone together while working full time. I should call her tomorrow at lunch and offer to have Pepper for a few days so she doesn't have to rush home. Also send Ollie something daft to cheer him up, he loves those Lego Star Wars sets.
Valentina says Jasmine's baby shower is the 26th, afternoon tea at the Grand. Kasia is organising and wants everyone to bring a children's book instead of a card.
Remind me to ring Uncle Marcus on Sunday morning, it's his 70th. He's into model railways, still hasn't finished the loft layout.
Meera's dad, Mr Patel, is having his cataract done the week after next. Meera's taking him in. Tanvi is back at school now, much better.

Petra's been signed off with burnout. Off for a month at least. She said she's okay but clearly not. Santiago is looking after things at home. Check in with her later this week, nothing heavy, maybe a walk.
Felix got into the county cricket squad! Trials were last Saturday. His mum Claire is over the moon.
Ming's mum is visiting from Shanghai sometime in March, for about three weeks. Ming wants to take her to the Lakes. Recommend that B&B near Grasmere.
Mariam's birthday next Tuesday. Into gardening, mostly roses, and she has a thing for those fancy Japanese secateurs. Get them ordered by Friday.

Had a proper catch up with Yusuf over curry. He's been having awful migraines and finally got a neuro referral, appointment on the 4th at 11:15. He's trying not to read too much into it. His wife Mariam keeps telling him to stop googling. Text him the morning of the 4th, and maybe again that evening to see how it went.
Jorge's nickname at work is apparently JJ. Everyone calls him that except his mum.
Sophie Brennan, Sophie B as everyone calls her, is going in for her wisdom teeth Thursday morning. Soft food only for a bit. She's dreading it.

Heather's son Callum has his driving test on the 19th at 2pm, third attempt, he's a wreck about it. Heather says don't mention it unless he does. Dafydd is taking him out for extra lessons beforehand.
Need to book train tickets for the weekend at Abigail's, leaving Friday after work.
Ebony and Kasia are both doing the Race for Life in May. Ebony's doing it for her nan who passed last year. Sponsor them both before the end of the month.
Eamon's sister Niamh is expecting! Due early spring. First grandchild for his parents, his mum is already knitting.

Went round to Caroline's. Her daughter Isla has been struggling at the new school, crying every morning. Caroline is meeting the head teacher Monday at 4. Her husband can't make it because of work, which she's annoyed about. Caroline's also been doing night shifts so she's frazzled. Isla is completely obsessed with horses, maybe find her a riding lesson voucher for her birthday in January.

Giulia rang about her nonna. She passed away on Saturday, 94. Funeral is in Bari sometime next week, Giulia's flying out Wednesday. Send her a message tonight, and something to the house when she's back.

Freya and her partner Jonah are doing a housewarming the Saturday after next, from 6. They've finally got the keys after nearly a year of the chain falling through. Jonah wants a plant for the garden, Freya just wants wine. Their dog Rolo will be there so warn Meera, she's allergic. Need to sort a present on Friday.
Amir is getting really into sourdough. Every conversation now. His starter is called Doughvid.
Saw Alice and Yara at the gym. Yara's back on crutches, she rolled her ankle at netball, and Alice is training for a triathlon in early September. Yara wants to come and watch.

Yosef said his boss is retiring end of the year and he's been asked to apply for the role. Interview isn't till January, probably the second week. He seemed pleased but nervous, he's never been through a proper panel interview. His partner Abigail thinks he's a shoo-in. I offered to do a mock interview with him over Christmas.
Luis's mum is having a knee replacement over Christmas. He's going home to Valencia for three weeks to help. Must remember to ask how it went when he's back in January.
Dentist Thursday at 9. Then gym. Groceries.
Alessia wants us all to go to Kasia's play next Friday night, it's at the Playhouse. Kasia has the lead and is apparently terrified. Book tickets tomorrow and send Kasia good luck on the day.
Valentina's partner Rosa has long covid, been off work since July. Some days she can't get out of bed. Valentina doesn't like talking about it much.
Zoe told me Marcus and his wife Lou split up a couple of weeks ago. He's staying at his brother's for now. Should invite him out for a pint soon, he's not great at reaching out.
Jasmine's son Leo turned 5 on Sunday. Didn't get anything to him in time. Drop off a present this week, he loves dinosaurs and anything that roars.
Meera and Tanvi Kaur are off to Mumbai for Diwali, back mid November. Their grandma's not well so it might be a longer stay.

Lovely call with Santiago. His dad is out of hospital after the heart scare and doing really well, walking every day. Santiago's taking him to the follow-up on the 30th at 10. His sister Valentina is coming over from Madrid for a few days around then too. Santiago is still pretty shaken by the whole thing though, he's not sleeping well. Send his dad a card, he'd like that.
Petra's daughter Ella just got into Edinburgh for medicine! Starts next September. Petra was crying on the phone.

Claire's birthday was yesterday and I completely forgot. Mortifying. Send her something today and take her out for lunch sometime next week to make up for it. She's into those Ottolenghi cookbooks, she doesn't have Simple.
Felix's grandma Mrs Jensen is in a care home now. Felix visits Sundays. He said she still beats him at Scrabble.
